description: Move an agent, an address (inbox), a domain, a webhook endpoint or a site (by its client id) into another pod of the account. An agent takes its addresses and their mail with it; an address that belongs to an agent moves only with it. API keys do not move. Needs the Everything level, of the whole account.

id.description: Its id; a site’s client id.

pod_id.description: The pod to move it into.

name: move_to_pod
title: Move into a pod
